MEASURE✂CUT✂STITCH✂DELIVER✂MEASURE✂CUT✂STITCH✂DELIVER✂

Bespoketailoring,aseasyasaddingtocart.

The problem

Online clothing is hard to get right on fit. Bespoke tailoring is trusted but slow to arrange and hard to price, and it rarely sits beside regular shopping.

The goal

One app where browsing, customizing, booking a tailor, paying and tracking feel like a single calm journey.

The approach

Ready-made and custom paths side by side, transparent measurements and pricing, and order status at every step.

Onboarding & Login

02

Home & Brands

Search sits first, followed by iconic brands, categories, new arrivals and trends. Long screens scroll inside the phone.

SearchIconic brandsCategoriesTrendingRecommended
BROWSE
03

Browse & Product

Brand pages add filters and a wishlist heart; the product page adds size, colour, delivery and reviews. Long screens scroll inside the phone.

FiltersWishlistSize & colourDelivery checkReviews
CUSTOM
04

Customize & Book

Pick fabric and fit, enter measurements in inches or cm, then book a tailor by date and time slot. Long screens scroll inside the phone.

Fabric swatchesFit optionsLive priceDate & slot
VERIFY
05

Confirm & Verify

A confirmation reassures the booking, then one last review of every measurement, option and cost. Long screens scroll inside the phone.

Editable visitMeasurementsPrice detailsDelivery estimate
CHECKOUT
06

Cart & Checkout

Cart totals include custom fees and a coupon field; checkout adds address, reserved visit and payment mode. Long screens scroll inside the phone.

Coupon codeCustom feesReserved visitCard · UPI · COD

Payment & Tracking

A success receipt leads into a stepped tracker with a live map and estimated delivery.
